, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted “paternal grandmother” as the father’s father’s mother (great-grandmother) and thus named Tai Si (mother of King Wu), despite having just confirmed from Wikipedia that King Cheng’s mother is Queen Yi Jiang—who is the correct paternal grandmother of King Kang of Zhou.
